actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong, FDR-significant pathway enrichment (coagulation, EMT up; metabolic/secretory down) and large effect sizes. WXS and CNV show only nominal trends, but the RNA signal is substantial and biologically interpretable. Measured technical factors do not provide a dominant explanation (no per-set significant confounders), and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent biological identity supported by strong RNA pathway enrichment (immune down, heme metabolism up) and consistent CNV losses on multiple arms, both FDR-significant. WXS shows only a nominal BAP1 depletion, but the RNA and CNV signals are coherent and not dominated by technical factors (no per-set significant confounders). Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 is better supported than Drop.

C0003 lacks a coherent biological identity: no RNA, WXS, or CNV features reached significance, with all effect sizes small and q-values near 1.0. The set is strongly confounded by CT manufacturer and scanner model (FDR-significant per-set associations), and its only strong structural signal is CT-driven, suggesting the identity may be primarily technical. No positive structural evidence supports Split or Merge, and no extra evidence is available to resolve the uncertainty. Dropping C0003 is better supported than retaining it.

C0004 lacks a coherent biological identity: no RNA, WXS, or CNV features reached significance, with all effect sizes moderate but q-values high. The set shows no significant technical confounders, but the absence of any FDR-significant biological signal across all modalities leaves no defensible molecular identity. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge, and no extra evidence is available. Dropping C0004 is better supported than retaining it.

C0005 has a coherent biological identity supported by strong RNA pathway enrichment (interferon and inflammatory pathways up) and significant BAP1 mutation enrichment, both FDR-significant with large effect sizes. The strong tissue-source-site association (CJ) provides a measured alternative explanation, but the molecular signal is robust and coherent across RNA and WXS, and the site association does not fully explain the biological findings. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0005 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
